name: Internship and Career Development Course
what_you_do: School course with weekly coaching on resumes, cover letters and interviews. You get an unpaid internship placement or prep for paid work. Sites include Davis Public Library, Davis Vanguard, Mercy General and Pemberton Engineering.
who_can_apply: Davis Joint Unified high school students. Some sites have priority rules (Dignity Health for Patient Care pathway students; Ford ACE for Transportation pathway students).
pay_detail: Unpaid internships; course credit with evaluation and reflection required.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. 2026-27 sites are listed now.
how_to_apply: Talk to your counselor or contact Internship Specialist Alexha Contreras (alcontreras@djusd.net, 530-757-5400 x170).
notes: Many other 2026-27 host sites are listed on the page; some have priority rules (Mercy General: Patient Care pathway students; Ford ACE: Transportation pathway students). Credit needs weekly meetings, an evaluation and a reflection. The page is written for DJUSD students.
